paragraphs: NCR Atleos Corporation ("Atleos," the "Company," "we," "us," and "our") is an industry-leading financial technology company providing self-directed banking solutions to a global customer base including financial institutions, merchants, manufacturers, retailers and consumers. Self-directed banking is a rapidly growing, secular trend that allows banking customers to transact seamlessly between various channels all for the same transaction. Our comprehensive solutions enable the acceleration of self-directed banking through automated teller machine ("ATM") and interactive teller machine ("ITM") technology, including software, services, hardware and our proprietary Allpoint network. While we provide all our solutions on a modular basis, we have also assembled these capabilities into a turnkey, end-to-end platform which we have branded "ATM as a Service." On October 16, 2023, we completed our separation from NCR Corporation (now known as NCR Voyix Corporation or "Voyix" and referred to as "NCR" prior to the Separation) and launched as an independent publicly-traded company (the "Separation" or "Spin-off"). Additional information about the Separation can be found in Note 1, "Basis of Presentation and Significant Accounting Policies", in Part II, Item 8 of this Annual Report on Form 10-K.

As ATM technology has evolved in recent years, the substantial majority of banking transactions can now be completed at the ATM, including cash deposits, withdrawals and other account services, as well as the origination of payments transactions such as bill payments and money transfer. In addition, the development of ITMs, which utilize remote bank employees to provide customer support and servicing via interactive video, enable customers to complete more complex transactions such as account opening, card issuance and replacement, and loan applications. We believe that ATMs and ITMs are increasingly the delivery channel of choice where transactions cannot be completed digitally, and for this reason, are critical to a broader strategy to provide convenient access for consumers.

The secular nature of the growth in self-directed banking is in large part responsive to how financial institutions interact with their customers and the ensuing implications to the traditional branch banking operational model. With retail banking customers increasingly receptive to engagement outside the traditional branch banking environment, financial institutions are investing in non-branch channels to foster enhanced engagement with their customers. As such, ATMs and ITMs represent an increasing share of transactions relative to the legacy branch infrastructure.

These shifts in engagement have meaningful operating implications, particularly in the face of sustained margin pressure across the banking industry. We believe that self-service banking capabilities, and self-directed banking more broadly, represent an opportunity for financial institutions to rationalize legacy branch networks and instead invest in omni-channel engagement models, often in partnership with third party providers as part of a comprehensive and more cost-effective solution.

Our solutions are designed to enable the acceleration of digital transformation through software, services, and hardware, creating meaningful operating efficiencies while offering differentiated user experiences to end consumers. ATM and ITM channels allow financial institutions to transform the traditional branch banking model and offer a more robust, efficient, and convenient banking experience to their customers.

Our solutions also offer distinct and powerful advantages to retailers and consumers. Through our ATMs and ITMs, retailers can create everyday banking destinations within their store footprints, driving new and repeat foot traffic and increased in-store spending while reducing the high labor costs associated with maintaining in-store financial services desks. Consumers benefit from increased convenience and connectivity through proximity to our network of approximately 78,000 self-service banking terminal locations, including the Allpoint network, which we believe is the largest retail surcharge-free independent network of ATMs in the U.S.

We believe our comprehensive capabilities differentiate us in the marketplace for self-directed banking technology. Historically, banks and retailers would negotiate with a wide array of third-party technology and service providers, pairing disparate systems with internally developed technologies to assemble a disjointed self-directed banking offering. Our customers, in contrast, benefit from a comprehensive outsourced solution to a single vendor, improving the functionality and availability of a self-directed banking network and the predictability of the cost to operate.

Given the demands of our customers, we are continuing our transition to software-led solutions. Today, our software platform, which runs in the cloud and includes microservices and application programming interfaces ("APIs") that integrate with our customers' systems, and our ATM as a Service solutions, bring together all our capabilities and competencies to power the technology to run our customers' self-directed banking networks, at the same time allowing us to earn a greater proportion of recurring revenues.

We have grown organically, as well as through acquisitions, to add software, services and other capabilities that complement or enhance our existing portfolio. We intend to continue pursuing opportunities to win new customers, expand our footprint and drive more transactions and foot traffic for our customers.

By delivering mission-critical solutions to a durable customer base under long term contracts, we generate diversified and largely recurring revenues across contracted software, services and predictable transactional revenue streams. We believe our global scale, operational expertise and efficient use of capital, as a percentage of revenues, position us to deliver meaningful free cash flow, with opportunities for further expansion as we pursue our growth objectives, undertake strategic acquisitions and return capital to our stockholders.
NCR Atleos Corporation's common stock is listed on the New York Stock Exchange ("NYSE") and trades under the symbol "NATL."
We manage our operations in the following segments: Self-Service Banking, Network, and Telecommunications & Technology ("T&T").

•Self-Service Banking - Offers solutions to enable customers in the financial services industry to reduce costs, generate new revenue streams and enhance customer loyalty. These solutions include a comprehensive line of ATM hardware and software, and related installation, maintenance, and managed and professional services. We also offer an ATM as a service ("ATMaaS") solution to manage and run the ATM channel end-to-end for financial institutions that include back office, cash management, software management and ATM deployment, among other services.

•Network - Provides a cost-effective way for financial institutions, financial technology companies ("fintechs"), neobanks, and retailers to reach and serve their customers through our network of ATMs and multi-functioning financial services kiosks. We offer credit unions, banks, digital banks, fintechs, stored-value debit card issuers, and other consumer financial services providers access to our ATM network, including our proprietary Allpoint network, providing convenient and fee-free cash withdrawal and deposit access to their customers and cardholders as well as the ability to convert a digital value to cash, or vice versa, via ReadyCode. We also provide ATM branding solutions to financial institutions, ATM management and services to retailers and other businesses, and our LibertyX solution gives consumers the ability to buy and sell Bitcoin.

paragraphs: The risks and uncertainties described below could materially and adversely impact our business, financial condition, results of operations, could cause actual results to differ materially from our expectations and projections, and could cause the market value of our stock to decline. You should consider these risk factors when evaluating us and our common stock and when reading the rest of this Annual Report on Form 10-K, including the sections entitled "Business" and "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations" and our financial statements and related notes included elsewhere in this document. These risk factors may not include all of the important factors that could affect our business or our industry or that could cause our future financial results to differ materially from historic or expected results or cause the market price of our common stock to fluctuate or decline. Additional risks and uncertainties not currently known to us or that we currently believe are immaterial also may impair our business, including our results of operations, liquidity and financial condition.

The following is a summary of the risks and uncertainties that could materially and adversely affect our business, financial condition, and results of operations. You should read this summary together with the more detailed description of each risk factor contained below.
•If we are unsuccessful in growing our business, our results could be negatively impacted.
•If we do not develop and introduce new solutions in the competitive, rapidly changing environment in which we do business, our business results may be impacted.
•If we do not compete effectively within the technology industry, we will not be successful.
•If we do not successfully integrate acquisitions or effectively manage alliance activities, we may not drive future growth.

paragraphs: NCR Atleos Corporation ("Atleos," the "Company," "we," "us," and "our") 為一間產業領先的財務科技公司，提供自助式銀行解決方案給全球客戶羣，包括金融機構、商家、製造商、零售商與消費者。自助式銀行為一項快速成長的長期趨勢，讓銀行客戶能在不同通路間順暢進行交易，且為同一筆交易。我們的全面解決方案透過自動櫃員機 ("ATM") 與互動式櫃員機 ("ITM") 技術，包括軟體、服務、硬體與我們的專有 Allpoint 網路，加速自助式銀行的發展。雖然我們以模組方式提供所有解決方案，我們也將這些能力整合為一體成套的端到端平台，並以 "ATM as a Service" 品牌化。於 2023 年 10 月 16 日，我們完成與 NCR Corporation (現稱為 NCR Voyix Corporation 或 "Voyix"，在分拆前稱為 "NCR") 的分拆，並成為一間獨立上市的公司 (稱為 "分拆" 或 " spin-off")。有關分拆的更多資訊，請參閱本年度 10-K 報告第二部分第 8 項 "呈列基礎與重要會計政策" 的附註 1。

隨著 ATM 技術近年來的演進，目前大多數銀行交易均可在 ATM 完成，包括現金存款、提款及其他帳戶服務，以及付款交易的發起，例如帳單支付與錢款轉帳。此外，互動式櫃員機 (ITMs) 的發展，利用遠端銀行員工透過互動視訊提供客戶支援與服務，使客戶得以完成更複雜的交易，例如開戶、卡片發行與更換，以及貸款申請。我們認為 ATM 與 ITMs 正成為無法透過數位完成交易的首選交付通路，因此對提供消費者便利存取的更廣泛策略至關重要。
自助式銀行成長的長期性，在很大程度上取決於金融機構如何與其客戶互動，以及對傳統分行銀行運營模式的影響。隨著零售銀行客戶越來越樂於在傳統分行環境之外進行互動，金融機構正在投資非分行通路，以促進與客戶的互動。因此，ATMs 與 ITMs 在交易中所佔的比例相對於傳統分行基礎設施而言正在增加。
這些互動方式的轉變對營運有著重要的影響，尤其是在銀行業持續面臨利潤壓力的情況下。我們認為，自助式銀行能力，以及更廣義的自助式銀行，為金融機構提供機會來合理化傳統分行網路，並轉而投資於全通路互動模式，通常與第三方供應商合作，作為一項全面且更具成本效益的解決方案的一部分。
我們的解決方案設計用以加速數位轉型，透過軟體、服務與硬體，創造重要的營運效率，同時為終端消費者提供差異化的使用體驗。ATM 與 ITM 通路讓金融機構能轉變傳統分行銀行模式，為其客戶提供更強大、高效且便利的銀行體驗。

我們的解決方案也為零售商與消費者提供獨特且強大的優勢。透過我們的 ATM 與 ITM，零售商可在其店面範圍內創造日常銀行服務據點，吸引新的與重複訪客，提高店面消費，同時降低維護店面金融服務櫃臺的高人力成本。消費者則能透過接近我們約 78,000 個自助式銀行終端機據點，包括 Allpoint 網路，享受更高的便利性與連線性，我們認為 Allpoint 網路是美國規模最大的零售免收費獨立 ATM 網路。
我們相信我們的全面能力在自助式銀行科技市場中具有區隔性。過去，銀行與零售商會與眾多第三方科技與服務供應商洽談，將不同的系統與內部開發的科技搭配，組合出一個零散的自助式銀行解決方案。與此相較，我們的客戶則能從單一供應商獲得全面的委外解決方案，提升自助式銀行網路的功能與可用性，並提高營運成本的可預測性。
根據我們客戶的需求，我們持續進行向軟體導向解決方案的轉型。目前，我們的軟體平台運行於雲端，包含微服務與應用程式程式介面 ("APIs")，這些介面可與客戶的系統整合，以及我們的 ATM as a Service 解決方案，將我們的所有能力與專業整合，用以運行客戶的自助式銀行網路，同時讓我們能獲得更高的經常性收入比例。
我們透過內生成長以及收購，已增加軟體、服務及其他能力，以補充或提升我們現有的產品組合。我們意圖持續尋找機會，爭取新客戶、擴大我們的業務版圖，並為客戶帶來更多交易與人潮。
透過向具備長期契約的穩定客戶提供關鍵業務解決方案，我們產生了多元且主要為持續性的收入，來自於 contracted 軟體、服務及可預測的交易收入流。我們相信，我們的全球規模、營運專業知識及資本使用效率（以收入為百分比計算），使我們有能力產生有意義的自由現金流，並在追求成長目標、進行戰略收購及回饋資本給股東的同時，尋求進一步擴張的機會。
NCR Atleos Corporation 的普通股於紐約證券交易所（"NYSE"）上市，並以符號 "NATL" 進行交易。
我們的業務運作分為以下應報告分部：自助銀行、網路，以及電信與科技（"T&T"）。
•自助銀行 - 提供解決方案，協助金融服務業客戶降低成本、產生新收入來源並提升客戶忠誠度。這些解決方案包括一整套 ATM 硬體與軟體，以及相關的安裝、維護及管理與專業服務。我們也提供 ATM 作為服務（"ATMaaS"）解決方案，協助金融機構管理並運作 ATM 頻道，從後臺作業、現金管理、軟體管理及 ATM 部署等服務。

•網路 - 提供金融機構、金融科技公司（"fintechs"）、新興銀行（neobanks）及零售商一種成本效益的方式，透過我們的 ATM 網路及多功能金融服務 kiosks 來接觸並服務客戶。我們提供信用合作社、銀行、數位銀行、金融科技公司、儲值信用卡發卡機構及其他消費者金融服務供應商接入我們的 ATM 網路，包括我們的專有 Allpoint 網路，讓其客戶及卡戶可以方便且免費用途提領現金與存款，並透過 ReadyCode 將數位價值轉換為現金，或反之亦然。我們也為金融機構提供 ATM 品牌解決方案，為零售商及其他企業提供 ATM 管理與服務，而我們的 LibertyX 解決方案則讓消費者可以買賣比特幣。

paragraphs: 本節應與本報告第二部分第 8 項所載經審計之合併財務報表及相關附註一併閱讀。管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之討論與分析包含前瞻性陳述。請參閱本年度 10-K 報告第 1A 項標題為「前瞻性陳述」及「風險因素」之節，以瞭解與這些前瞻性陳述相關之不確定性、風險與假設，這些因素可能導致未來結果與本節所反映者有重大差異。
我們在管理層討論與分析（MD&A）中之討論為以下結構：
•總覽。本節包含本公司之背景資訊、年度內重要主題與事件之總結，以及戰略性計畫與趨勢，以提供管理層對本公司財務狀況與營運成果之討論與分析之脈絡。
•營運成果。本節包含對本公司營運成果之分析，該分析係透過比較截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日止年度與截至 2024 年 12 月 31 日止年度之營運成果，並載於隨附之合併營運狀況表中。請參閱下述標題為「從 NCR 分拆」之節，以取得截至 2023 年 12 月 31 日止年度之財務報表呈現基礎之額外資訊。
•流動性與資本資源。本節提供對本公司現金流量之分析，並討論截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日之契約義務。
•關鍵會計估計。本節包含對我們認為與財務狀況與營運成果重要，且需管理層判斷與估計之會計政策之討論。此外，我們所有重要會計政策，包括關鍵會計政策，均於第二部分第 8 項所載合併財務報表附註中「財務報表呈現基礎與重要會計政策」（Note 1）中總結。
有關管理層對截至 2024 年 12 月 31 日止年度之合併營運成果與截至 2023 年 12 月 31 日止年度之比較，以及與財務年度 2023 相關之其他財務資訊，請參閱我們於 2025 年 11 月 5 日提交至 SEC 之 2024 年修正後年度報告（2024 Form 10-K/A）所載第 7 項「管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之討論與分析」。

Atleos 是一家在金融科技領域處於領先地位之公司，提供自導式銀行解決方案給全球客戶羣，包括金融機構、商家、製造商、零售商與消費者。自導式銀行是一項快速成長的長期趨勢，使銀行客戶能在不同通路間順暢進行交易，且為同一筆交易。我們的全面解決方案透過自動櫃員機（ATM）與互動式櫃員機（ITM）科技，包括軟體、服務、硬體與我們專屬的 Allpoint 網路，加速自導式銀行。雖然我們以模組方式提供所有解決方案，但我們也將這些能力組合成一個完整的端到端平台，並以品牌「ATM as a Service」標榜。
Atleos 運作兩個領先的業務分部，專注於透過 ATM 提供自助銀行服務，並透過一套共用的工具、系統與平台支援。此外，我們也運作一個電信與科技（"T&T"）分部，提供受託管理的網路與基礎設施服務給各產業的企業客戶，透過與電信服務供應商及科技製造商的直接關係。
我們的業務運作分為以下分部：自助銀行、網路與 T&T。
•自助銀行 - 提供解決方案，協助金融服務業客戶降低營運成本、創造新收入來源並提升客戶忠誠度。這些解決方案包括一整套 ATM 硬體與軟體，以及相關的安裝、維護與受託及專業服務。我們也提供 ATM 作為服務（"ATMaaS"）解決方案，協助金融機構管理並運作 ATM 頻道，從後臺作業、現金管理、軟體管理與 ATM 部署等服務。

•網路 - 提供金融機構、金融科技公司、新興銀行與零售業者透過我們的 ATM 網路與多功能金融服務 kiosks 來接觸與服務客戶的高成本效益方式。我們提供信用合作社、銀行、數位銀行、金融科技公司、儲值信用卡發卡機構及其他消費者金融服務供應商存取我們的 ATM 網路，包括我們的專屬 Allpoint 網路，讓客戶與卡戶可方便且免費用現金提領與存款，並透過 ReadyCode 將數位價值轉換為現金，或反之亦然。我們也為金融機構提供 ATM 品牌解決方案，為零售業及其他企業提供 ATM 管理與相關服務，我們的 LibertyX 解決方案讓消費者可買賣比特幣。
•T&T - 透過與電信服務供應商及科技製造商的直接關係，為各產業的企業客戶提供受託管理的網路與基礎設施服務。我們的客戶將我們視為戰略夥伴，協助他們降低複雜度、提高成本效益並實現全球地理範圍的拓展。我們提供專業、現場與遠端服務，以支援現代網路科技，包括軟體定義廣域網路、網路功能虛擬化、無線區域網路、光纖網路與邊緣網路。
2023 年 10 月 16 日，NCR Corporation（現稱為 NCR Voyix Corporation 或 "Voyix"，在討論分拆前的時期時稱為 "NCR"）完成了將其自助銀行、網路與電信與科技業務分拆給 NCR 股東（"分拆" 或 "分離"）。與分拆同時，我們成為一家獨立上市的公司，我們的財務報表現已以合併基礎呈現。

我們的歷史及持續製造活動使我們面臨環境風險。
氣候變遷可能對我們的業務產生長期不利影響。
資料保護、網路安全及資料隱私權問題可能對我們的業務產生不利影響。
我們的負債程度可能對我們的業務、財務狀況及營運成果產生重大且不利的影響。
